decisions.statement: The counts are taken again whenever a page of a counted type moves.
Which folders hold the pages of a counted type is asked of the index.
One take is made when the watch opens.
A take finding the same counts as the take before writes nothing.
A count is written onto the tracking day.
A count is kept beside the readout that count was taken for.
A count is carried to the site showing that count.
A count kept beside a readout is the count that take made rather than a count read back off the day.
A take arriving while a take runs is made once the running take is done.
Two takes never run at once.
A take opening is where this watch leaves for code that moved.
No take is running there, which is what makes a take opening a safe point.
A take left rather than made is made again by the watch that opens next.
The day written and the day counted are one ESO day settled once.
A throw says its reason and ends the run rather than being passed over.
The timers taking the task counts run whatever the watch does.
Nothing here waits on a beat.
A page folder that came after the watch opened is followed once it is there.

definition: the task counts kept current as pages land
